thesis: Bolt is the dominant ride-hailing platform in Tanzania (Africa's fastest-growing rides market in Bolt's 2025 report, +68% YoY, 8 Tanzanian cities, 30k+ drivers) and is newly licensed in Zanzibar (Aug/Sep 2025). It is also live on the Kenyan coast (Mombasa, Diani, southern Kilifi). The East African coast + Zanzibar archipelago is a dense, tourism-heavy, ferry-dependent water cluster where Navier fast-electric craft shortcut slow/rough/congested surface crossings. This is a reusable coastal-cluster asset for future proposals (Uber, Yango, hospitality).
scope_reintroduction_note: Kenya was dropped as a STANDALONE node in PR #83 (too weak alone). This cluster reintroduces Kenya only as part of a coastal East-Africa cluster (Mombasa/Diani + Tanzanian coast + Zanzibar/Pemba/Mafia archipelago). Different, stronger thesis; not a reversal of the standalone decision.
